plan: PLAN.md Phase 3: a confirmed drift trains a challenger, which replaces the current model in the Unity Catalog registry only if it wins on held-out data; plus the CI accuracy gate
trigger: a month in workspace.cdm.gold_drift_monthly with an alert that contains Buenos Aires images (the replay's months 7 to 9); the job refuses to run without one
champion: the shipped EfficientNet-B0 v2 ensemble (seeds 0 to 2, checkpoints checked by weight hash), registered as workspace.cdm.skin_lesion_classifier@champion

challenger.data: the clients' training split plus the labelled Buenos Aires images the monthly job scored in months 5 to 9 (their labels have arrived)
challenger.training: cdm.train.train with the v2 settings (B0, 224 px, centre view), 3 epochs, learning rate 1e-4, epoch chosen on the clients' validation split; seeds 0 to 2
challenger.compute: one Databricks serverless GPU task (A10), a 45-minute deadline, inside the owner's 2-hour cap

held_out: labelled Buenos Aires images of patients with no image in the challenger's training data (patient-disjoint; lesion ID where no patient is recorded); these images were scored in earlier phases' external evaluations, so this is an operational decision, not a new benchmark
comparison: champion and challenger ensembles (mean of 3 seeds' softmax) on the held-out images and on the clients' validation split; balanced accuracy over the classes present; paired bootstrap of the difference (1,000 resamples by patient, else lesion, seed 0)
promotion_rule: promote only if (a) on held-out Buenos Aires the challenger's balanced accuracy is at least 2.0 points higher and the paired 95% interval's lower bound is above 0, and (b) on client validation it is no more than 1.0 point lower. Client validation also chose the challenger's epoch, so (b) is lenient; this is stated
if_promoted: the challenger checkpoints and the decision are written to the volume and workspace.cdm.gold_model_decisions; the registry alias moves only after a serving bundle is rebuilt for the challenger (detectors refit on CPU) and checked, which is a separate run
if_not_promoted: the decision (kept) is recorded; nothing in the registry changes
ci_gate: config/eval_gate.json holds floors for the champion's committed metrics; tests/test_eval_gate.py fails the build if the serving results fall below them or if a promotion record shows a challenger below them
